title: Majestic Reef Fish
description: A large, colorful fish with blue, yellow, and black patterned scales swims toward the viewer in the center of a vibrant underwater coral reef. Sunlight beams penetrate from the surface above, illuminating the scene filled with smaller fish, sea plants, and diverse coral formations.
prompt: A large tropical fish with intricate blue, yellow, and black patterns and a large golden eye swims forward in the center of a lush coral reef. Sunlight rays pierce through the deep blue water from above, surrounded by smaller fish and vibrant corals in purple, orange, and green. Highly detailed underwater scene with realistic lighting and cinematic atmosphere.
